speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia. To understand the root cause, can you tell me if your symptoms were sudden in onset or did they develop gradually over time? Have you experienced any episodes of double vision, slurred speech, or numbness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; the asymmetry suggests a focal neurological issue rather than a systemic one. Has anyone noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision, or any difficulty with swallowing or speaking? Also, do you have a history of diabetes or hypertension, and have you been experiencing any recent headaches or dizziness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC virus antibody status in CSF.
